configuration: Node 24.14.0; solc-js 0.8.30 optimizer 200, EVM Paris; ethers 6.15.0; Ganache 7.9.2 Shanghai, chain ID 31337
human_review: unavailable and forbidden by benchmark isolation

candidates.title: Borrow callback reentrancy finalizes debt after value transfer
candidates.severity_rationale: An untrusted collateral borrower can recursively extract stable liquidity while every nested health check observes stale debt; impact scales to market liquidity.
candidates.root_cause: Stable transfer and attacker-controlled receiver callback occur before debt is incremented, with no reentrancy guard or checks-effects-interactions ordering.
candidates.attacker_capabilities: Ordinary borrower may deploy a callback receiver, deposit legitimate collateral, and choose nonempty borrow data.
preconditions: Market has stable liquidity
Attacker has a legitimate collateral position and contract receiver
transaction_sequence: Both frames add debt only while unwinding
candidates.demonstrated_impact: Final debt and attacker stable balance are 1,500e18 while borrow limit remains 750e18.
candidates.negative_case: Empty callback data produces one borrow with debt exactly equal to the 750e18 limit.

candidates.title: Bridge credit does not authenticate remote application sender
candidates.severity_rationale: Any remote application whose message is honestly relayed from a configured chain can mint arbitrary unbacked bridge collateral and drain market stable liquidity.
candidates.root_cause: The gateway reads xDomainMessageSender only for an event and never compares it with remoteGateway[sourceChain].
candidates.attacker_capabilities: Untrusted remote application may originate a message that the trusted messenger relays with its authentic mismatching source sender.
preconditions: Source chain has any configured remote
Gateway is the market bridge
Market has stable liquidity
transaction_sequence: Admin configures remote A for chain 10
candidates.demonstrated_impact: Mismatching sender receives 1,000e18 bridge credit and 750e18 stable without locked collateral.
candidates.negative_case: Corrected comparator binds source sender to configured gateway: wrong sender rejects with zero credit; correct sender succeeds.

candidates.title: Permit relayer can redirect signed transfer
candidates.severity_rationale: A relayer can steal the entire signed and approved amount by substituting its own unsigned recipient.
candidates.root_cause: Recipient is omitted from both TRANSFER_TYPEHASH and the signed payload but is consumed by transferFrom.
candidates.attacker_capabilities: Permissionless relayer possesses a legitimate owner signature and chooses public recipient calldata.
preconditions: Owner approved router
Owner issued the contract-prescribed signature
transaction_sequence: Owner intends recipient R and signs 25e18 action
Router transfers owner tokens to relayer
candidates.demonstrated_impact: Intended recipient balance stays zero; attacker receives 25e18 and consumes owner nonce.
candidates.negative_case: Altering encoded amount by one wei invalidates signature and leaves balance/nonce zero.

candidates.title: ECDSA malleability bypasses reward replay protection
candidates.severity_rationale: Every legitimate reward authorization can be paid twice using its equivalent high-s encoding, exceeding signer intent and draining distributor funds.
candidates.root_cause: Recovery accepts noncanonical high-s signatures while replay protection keys raw signature bytes rather than payload identity.
candidates.attacker_capabilities: Claimant or relayer has one legitimate authority signature and can transform public ECDSA values without the private key.
preconditions: Distributor holds at least twice the claim amount
One valid authority-signed claim exists
transaction_sequence: Submit alternate bytes for identical payload
Both distinct byte hashes are marked used
candidates.demonstrated_impact: One 20e18 authorization pays 40e18; both encodings recover the same authority.
candidates.negative_case: Byte-identical replay rejects and total paid remains 20e18.

candidates.title: StrategyModule can be reinitialized and seized
candidates.severity_rationale: Any account can overwrite established vault/operator roles, sweep all held tokens, and acquire arbitrary-call authority.
candidates.root_cause: initialize has neither caller authorization nor a !initialized lifecycle guard and always overwrites both roles.
candidates.attacker_capabilities: Any untrusted EOA can call the public initializer after honest setup.
preconditions: Module is deployed, honestly initialized, and holds tokens or privileged integrations
transaction_sequence: Attacker calls sweep for full module balance
candidates.demonstrated_impact: Original roles are replaced and attacker drains all 10e18 test tokens; arbitrary execute authority is also acquired.
candidates.negative_case: Without reinitialization, direct attacker sweep rejects and module retains all tokens.

candidates.title: Any user can raise the global collateral factor
candidates.severity_rationale: An ordinary borrower can weaken a guardian risk control globally and immediately borrow materially above the configured limit.
candidates.root_cause: The guardian conditional rejects non-guardians only for decreases, accidentally authorizing every increase up to 9,500 bps.
candidates.attacker_capabilities: Any protocol user can call the public risk setter and borrow against ordinary collateral.
preconditions: Factor is below 9,500 bps
Attacker has collateral
Market has stable liquidity
candidates.demonstrated_impact: Debt/stable becomes 949e18, 199e18 above the original authorized limit; global factor is 9,500.
candidates.negative_case: The same non-guardian is rejected when lowering factor to 7,000, isolating the inverted direction.

candidates.title: Bridge replay nonce is global across source chains
candidates.severity_rationale: A valid user message on one configured domain can block an unrelated same-nonce message on another, stranding collateral/credit across independent nonce sequences.
candidates.root_cause: processedNonce keys only uint64 nonce and omits sourceChain despite per-chain remote configuration.
candidates.attacker_capabilities: Remote user can cause a legitimate configured-gateway bridge message on one source chain.
preconditions: At least two source chains are configured
Their independent local nonce streams reuse a value
candidates.demonstrated_impact: Chain 10 beneficiary receives 1e18 credit; chain 20 victim receives zero despite authentic configured sender and chain.
candidates.negative_case: Chain-scoped replay-key comparator accepts both messages and credits both beneficiaries.

candidates.title: Manipulable reserve spot price is trusted during feed fallback
candidates.severity_rationale: During an honest primary-feed failure, an ordinary funded swapper can inflate the fallback spot price and create profitable bad debt; conditional capital needs reduce it below Critical.
candidates.root_cause: Oracle fallback consumes the instantaneous permissionlessly manipulable reserve ratio without TWAP, delay, or manipulation bound.
candidates.attacker_capabilities: Ordinary funded user may swap, vault acquired collateral, deposit it, and borrow.
preconditions: Primary feed returns nonpositive
Reserve pool and market have liquidity
Attacker can fund a swap comparable to pool depth
candidates.demonstrated_impact: Attacker ends with ~14,955 liquid stable after starting/spending 10,000; debt exceeds one-dollar safe limit (~3,744) by >11,210.
candidates.negative_case: Positive one-dollar primary feed ignores identical pool manipulation and rejects 10,000 borrow with debt zero.

candidates.title: Positive primary price is accepted indefinitely
candidates.severity_rationale: A stale positive round after a price decline permits immediate borrowing far above current collateral value without attacker control of the feed.
candidates.root_cause: Oracle discards updatedAt/round metadata and treats every positive answer as valid forever.
candidates.attacker_capabilities: Ordinary borrower can wait, deposit collateral, and borrow; cannot set the feed.
preconditions: Last positive feed price is stale and above current value
Market has stable liquidity
transaction_sequence: 31,536,001 seconds elapse; pool value is 1 dollar
candidates.demonstrated_impact: Debt is 1,500e18 against a current pool-based 750e18 limit.
candidates.negative_case: One-day freshness-bound comparator falls back to one-dollar pool value and rejects the same 1,500 borrow.

candidates.title: Permit signature replays across router instances
candidates.severity_rationale: One valid transfer authorization can execute once per approved router deployment because verifier instances maintain independent nonce stores.
candidates.root_cause: Signed payload omits address(this) and block.chainid while nonce is local to each router.
candidates.attacker_capabilities: Permissionless relayer possesses one valid signature and can submit it to approved router instances.
preconditions: Owner approved at least two router instances
Both owner nonces match at signing
transaction_sequence: Owner signs 25e18 for router A payload
Relayer replays same signature on B
candidates.demonstrated_impact: One 25e18 authorization transfers 50e18 to the same recipient, with nonce one in each router.
candidates.negative_case: Comparator binds router address and chain: A succeeds, B rejects, B nonce remains zero, only 25e18 transfers.

candidates.title: First-share donation can deny vault deposits
candidates.severity_rationale: A front/back-running attacker can repeatedly deny deposits with recoverable capital, but causes no victim asset theft and temporarily commits capital comparable to the blocked amount.
candidates.root_cause: Initial exchange-rate math has no virtual shares/assets or minimum-liquidity offset, so direct donations inflate a one-share position until victim deposits round to zero.
candidates.attacker_capabilities: Ordinary token holder can seed one share, directly transfer owned underlying, order around victim transaction, and redeem.
preconditions: Vault is empty or reset to a tiny supply
Attacker temporarily has capital at least comparable to target deposit
Transaction ordering is available
transaction_sequence: Deposit one wei for one share
Redeem one share and recover all capital
candidates.demonstrated_impact: Victim receives zero shares/service while retaining funds; attacker recovers starting 1000e18+1 balance with zero capital loss aside from gas/opportunity cost.
candidates.negative_case: Without donation, identical victim deposit succeeds and mints 1,000e18 shares.
